data.content_ref: inline:Add bounded defense-depth labels alongside grounded status: run the grounded fixpoint once, then compute for each accepted node the minimal length of a defense tree (or ∞ if none) and for each out node the set of attacking accepted nodes. These depth tags are derived from the final fixed point, not part of the iteration, so determinism and polynomial cost are preserved. They strengthen the semantics by exposing why a conjecture is accepted or refuted without changing any label. Committed roots get depth 0 and remain valid. Weakness: post-hoc tags cannot influence the fixpoint, so they are explanatory only; if the goal is to change acceptance, this candidate is too weak.
